newsitem.title: USA: NYPA says shutting Indian Point 3 for repairs.
newsitem.headline: NYPA says shutting Indian Point 3 for repairs.

text.p: The New York Power Authority (NYPA) said it is briefly shutting its 965 megawatt (MW) Indian Point 3 nuclear power plant so workers can reposition an electrical conduit in the non-nuclear part of the plant.
"Electricity production is expected to be interrupted for several hours Thursday," the state power company said in a statement.
The conduit, part of the wiring for the system that monitors the flow of electricity from the unit's generator, had become detached, NYPA said.
NYPA said it started throttling back the plant's output late Wednesday.

The federal Nuclear Regulatory Commission reported early Thursday that Indian Point 3, at Indian Point in Buchanan, N.Y., was currently producing at about 40 percent of its rated capacity and reducing power for the repair work.
NYPA produces about a fourth of all electricity generated in the state of New York.
